candidates.baseline_failure_evidence: V5-V18 mechanism families did not establish a meaningful gain; the frozen CE+Lovasz always-fuse comparator remains the only accepted reference.
candidates.bottleneck: The final optical-SAR residual can move in classifier-visible directions that overwrite task-relevant local complementarity, while classifier-tangent information is not directly constrained.
candidates.mechanism_hypothesis: Constrain only the classifier-visible component of the final multimodal residual and preserve its classifier-tangent complement, improving task-compatible information flow without adding parameters or inference modules.
candidates.information_flow_delta: The final fused residual is decomposed in the detached shared-classifier geometry; only the row-space displacement is capped before the unchanged head, while the tangent component bypasses the cap.
candidates.operation_delta: At the final 15x15 post-fusion/pre-classifier hook, apply fixed-rcond float32 K-space projection and token-wise class-logit displacement bound tau=2.1722421646118164; preserve tangent residual.
candidates.screening_observable: finite K-space solve, numerical rank, tangent leakage, class-logit bound violation, single backbone forward, unchanged state-dict/trainability surface, and validation curve
candidates.hard_falsifier: Any label/argmax use, second CROMA pass, explicit inverse or dense projector, parity/finite/rank/leakage/bound failure, or best validation mIoU below 50.78078791964122% closes the route; 50.7808% to <51.7808% is marginal only.
candidates.implementation_plan: Reuse the shared OpticalSarTokenModel and classifier; insert the parameter-free CTSP operator only at final-stage post-fusion, with C1/C2/C3 controls locked until the +2pp gate.
candidates.resource_feasibility: Zero added trainable parameters, one 11x11 Gram solve, 225x768 token carrier, single CROMA forward, and the frozen micro-batch16/effective-batch32 AMP path are compatible with RTX 3090 24GB.
candidates.resource_risk: Small float32 classifier-geometry solve under AMP and validation of the calibrated tau; no additional attention or backbone pass.
candidates.prior_art_boundary: Classifier null/range geometry, pseudoinverse, orthogonal decomposition, residual clipping, multimodal fusion and CROMA are borrowed/known components; only the narrow bounded final residual operation is tested.
candidates.selection_rationale: Single approved route with a parameter-free structural operation that directly targets the residual geometry bottleneck and has explicit matched controls.
candidates.rebuttal: The strongest objection is that CTSP may reduce to generic clipping or classifier-null projection; the predeclared isotropic whole-residual and identity controls, fixed tau calibration and tangent/bound telemetry provide falsifiable separation.

mechanism_review.finding: The operation changes final residual information flow and is parameter-free; it is not loss-only or a cosmetic module swap.

prior_art_review.finding: Broad null-space/orthogonal claims are rejected; the narrow operation is retained with high-overlap attribution and a bounded novelty claim.

resource_review.finding: The detached 11x11 Gram geometry adds no trainable state and fits the measured RTX 3090 single-forward budget.

adversarial_review.finding: The route has explicit rank, finite, tangent-leakage, class-bound, parity and +1/+2pp falsifiers; controls remain locked until the support gate.
